ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity contrast; approximately 85% high-value white pixels to 15% low-value black pixels within the fluke boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous area across both lobes; low-intensity black pixels concentrated in a continuous band along the trailing edge and an irregular cluster at the median notch and fluke base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 110 degrees and a vertical depth comprising approximately 12% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations with pixel amplitudes of 3-10 pixels along the entire trailing edge; serrations become more irregular and clustered at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly concave trailing edge trajectory from notch to distal tips; lobes exhibit a convex leading edge curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, textured pixel anomalies (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; sparse dark spotting in the lower-central ventral region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast brownish linear disruptions visible on the inner-left lobe surface, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of bio-fouling/parasitic attachments at the distal margins of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Water spray and specular highlights partially occluding the pixel data at the fluke-water interface.
